title: Check a project against the house layout — check_project
text: rule finding prints one PASS line. finding prints one line: PASS|WARN|FAIL  <rule>  <detail>. count line comes last. Every rule reads one set files folders: path top folder git repository, set output git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard. tracked files, untracked files git ignore. Otherwise, set every file folder disk. sets leave .DS_Store, .Rhistory, .RData, Word lock files ~$*, everything .git/ .Rproj.user/. rules: lower_case_names (FAIL): file folder name capital letter. Everything background/ checked. exempt: README.md, CHANGELOG.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, LICENSE, DESCRIPTION, top-level dotfile, top-level *.Rproj file, file extensions, initials manuscript/manual/vNN_<INITIALS>.docx. run_script_initialises (FAIL): vNN_run.R top level call pbn::initialize_project() whose version argument string "vNN". version_items_complete (FAIL): vNN_run.R vNN_functions/, reverse. results_contract (FAIL): vNN_results/results.qs2 vNN_results/scenario/<name>/results.qs2 fails check_results(). manual_manuscript_names (FAIL): file manuscript/manual/ match ^v[0-9]{2}_[-Z]{2,4}[0-9]?\.docx$. no_local_copy_of_pbn_function (FAIL): top-level assignment vNN_functions/*.R file defines function name pbn export. loc_per_file (FAIL): .R file 1000 code lines, counted org::loc_per_file(). no_environment_variables (FAIL): run script file functions folder uses Sys.getenv Sys.setenv. unknown_path (WARN): house layout name top-level file folder. top-level dotfile top-level *.Rproj file never unknown. R parser, regular expression, finds calls, assignments symbols. file pbn_allow.txt project folder MAY list exceptions. Write one rule<TAB>path per line, path relative project folder. allowed finding prints WARN, (allowed) end. entry matches finding prints WARN rule pbn_allow.

title: Check a project against the house layout — check_project
code: home <- file.path(tempdir(), "pbn_check_example") dir.create(file.path(home, "v01_functions"), recursive = TRUE) writeLines(   'pbn::initialize_project(version = "v01", home = ".", data_raw = "x")',   file.path(home, "v01_run.R") ) pbn::check_project(home) #> PASS  lower_case_names  no capital letter in a name #> PASS  run_script_initialises  every vNN_run.R calls pbn::initialize_project() with its own version #> PASS  version_items_complete  every vNN_run.R has a vNN_functions/, and the reverse #> PASS  results_contract  every vNN_results/results.qs2 and vNN_results/scenario/*/results.qs2 passes check_results() #> PASS  manual_manuscript_names  every file in manuscript/manual/ is named vNN_<INITIALS>.docx #> PASS  no_local_copy_of_pbn_function  no vNN_functions/ file defines a pbn export #> PASS  loc_per_file  no .R file has more than 1000 code lines #> PASS  no_environment_variables  no Sys.getenv or Sys.setenv in a run script or a functions folder #> PASS  unknown_path  the house layout names every top-level path #> 9 PASS, 0 WARN, 0 FAIL  unlink(home, recursive = TRUE)

title: Check a results object against the contract — check_results
code: x <- list(   manifest = list(n_rows_data = 100L),   exclusions = data.frame(     step = "age 18 or more",     n_before = 100,     n_excluded = 4,     n_after = 97   ),   estimates = data.frame(term = "x", estimate = 1.2),   tables = list(),   extra = list() ) pbn::check_results(x) #>                rule status                                            detail #> 1   top_level_names   PASS           the five top-level names, and no others #> 2  exclusions_table   FAIL n_before - n_excluded != n_after on these rows: 1 #> 3  no_fitted_models   PASS                     no fitted model in the object #> 4 no_row_per_person   PASS                        no data.frame has 100 rows
